jobs.occupation: Associate Director, Global Drug Safety & Pharmacovigilance Physician
jobs.description:
At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**The Role

**This role provides medical oversight of product safety, including adverse event review, ongoing safety surveillance, and management of emerging safety issues. Responsibilities include safety input to clinical and regulatory deliverables, aggregate reporting, safety committee oversight, cross-functional collaboration, and ensuring regulatory compliance and inspection readiness.

**Responsibilities

**

• Perform medical review of Adverse Events reports for Genmab products.

• Perform ongoing surveillance of safety data from Genmab clinical trials.

• Ensure handling of safety issues.

• Perform medical review and provide input to e.g., Trial Protocols and amendments, Trial Reports, Trial plans, eCRFs/CRFs, TMFs, Investigator’s Brochures, Subject Informed Consent, Development Safety Update Reports, Integrated Safety Summaries, scientific articles, and medical reviews.

• Prepare aggregated reports and safety summaries in accordance with regulatory requirements.

• Responsible for the establishment and management of external Data Monitoring Committees (DMCs)

• Chair and manage Genmab Safety Committees

• Conduct training of Genmab employees, CROs and Investigators

• Member of Clinical Management Teams (CMTs), Compound Development Teams (CDT) and Compound Strategy Teams (CST) and contribute to multidisciplinary project groups and provide input to clinical development programs.

• Interact with safety and clinical CROs and perform sponsor oversight activities.

• Collaborate with external experts and partners.

• Contribute to multidisciplinary project groups.

• Ensure compliance with regulatory guidelines and internal procedures in order to be prepared for audits and inspections.

• Participate in audit and inspection activities as relevant

**Requirements

**

• Medical degree (MD or equivalent) with relevant clinical experience; oncology or hematology experience preferred.

• 5 - 8 years of experience in pharmacovigilance, drug safety, or clinical development within the pharmaceutical/biotechnology industry.

• Demonstrated experience in adverse event medical review, safety surveillance, signal evaluation, benefit–risk assessment, and aggregate safety reporting.

• Experience providing medical safety input to clinical trials and regulatory deliverables, including protocols, Investigator’s Brochures, informed consent documents, DSURs, clinical study reports, and integrated safety summaries.

• Strong knowledge of global pharmacovigilance and clinical development requirements, with experience supporting Safety Committees/DMCs, regulatory submissions, audits, and inspections.

• Strong medical judgment, leadership, and communication skills, with demonstrated ability to collaborate across functions, CROs, external partners, and regulatory stakeholders.

• Experience executing processes/projects in own area (e.g. guidance documents as per intl. regulations & reporting requirements; preparation of post-marketing spontaneous and clinical trial safety assessments; regulatory submissions; safety case processing; PV data systems; safety data base systems and the report generation)

• Experience working with FDA/EMA/PMDA/ICH requirements, good clinical practices, and pharmaceutical clinical development

• Experience guiding team members around complex issues

For US based candidates, the proposed salary band for this position is as follows:

$200,000.00---$300,000.00

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Also, certain positions are eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

When You Join Genmab, You’re Joining a Culture That Supports Your Physical, Financial, Social, And Emotional Wellness. Within The First Year, Regular Full-time U.S. Employees Are Eligible For

• 401(k) Plan: 100% match on the first 6% of contributions

• Health Benefits: Two medical plan options (including HDHP with HSA), dental, and vision insurance

• Voluntary Plans: Critical illness, accident, and hospital indemnity insurance

• Time Off: Paid vacation, sick leave, holidays, and 12 weeks of discretionary paid parental leave

• Support Resources: Access to child and adult backup care, family support programs, financial wellness tools, and emotional well-being support

• Additional Perks: Commuter benefits, tuition reimbursement, and a Lifestyle Spending Account for wellness and personal expenses

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on role will be provided during the recruitment process

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

Please note that if you are applying for a position in the Netherlands, Genmab’s policy for all permanently budgeted hires in NL is initially to offer a fixed-term employment contract for a year, if the employee performs well and if the business conditions do not change, renewal for an indefinite term may be considered after the fixed-term employment contract.

Board Intelligence is a technology and advisory firm on a mission to make boards more effective, and through them, build better businesses and benefit society.

Over twenty years we have established ourselves as the market leader in governance and board effectiveness, trusted by more than 80,000 directors, executives, and governance professionals globally, including across the Fortune 500, FTSE 100, and OMX 30. That trust has been earned through depth of insight, rigorous advisory work, and a track record that newer entrants simply cannot replicate.

We have invested in applied AI since 2020, well ahead of the market, and that early conviction has paid off. Our AI-powered platform and smart board advisor give us a competitive advantage that is widening, not narrowing. In 2024, K1 Investment Management, the leading B2B Enterprise SaaS investor, backed us to accelerate that position further. We are now growing fast, with a proven commercial model spanning both mid-market and enterprise, and a product suite that has become a necessary addition in high-stakes board environments.

The people joining us now will shape how we scale. We are deliberate about how we do that. Our founders and leadership team are deeply invested in keeping the culture that got us here: thoughtful, high calibre, and genuinely human. Ambition and balance are not in competition at Board Intelligence.

If you want to work at the intersection of AI and governance, on problems that matter at the highest level, this is a strong place to be.

Our Mission

We unleash the potential of organisations through the science of board effectiveness, building better businesses and benefitting society.

**The Role

**Juristic is a Danish legal tech company, founded in 2021 and headquartered in Copenhagen. Our platform brings four tools together on the same case data: Structure, Timeline, Flow and JuristIQ, our legal AI in chat and tabular formats.

Clients include PwC, Bird & Bird and Bech-Bruun. Juristic is now part of Board Intelligence, and we are bringing a new product to market. The work is led by our CTO, and we are looking for an AI Engineer to build it with them from the first line of code.

This is a zero-to-one role in a small team of four full-stack developers, a machine learning engineer and the CTO. You will write the code, sit in front of customers, and help decide what we build next.

**Main Responsibilities

**

• Design, build and ship the AI capabilities at the core of a new product, from first prototype to production

• Own LLM-powered workflows end to end, such as document understanding, data extraction and agentic assistants

• Choose and integrate models and providers, and own the prompting, retrieval, evaluation and guardrails that make AI output reliable enough for legal and governance work

• Work directly with customers and the CTO to turn real problems into product decisions, and help own the product roadmap

• Lay the engineering foundations for the new product, including architecture, testing, observability and deployment, so it can scale

• Work with the wider Juristic and Board Intelligence engineering teams, and contribute to AI tooling shared across the suite

**Person Specification

**We are looking for a builder: an experienced AI engineer who has been a technical founder or an early employee at a startup, and who is ready to do it again.

Required Skills and Experience:

• At least four years of professional software engineering experience

• Experience as a technical founder or early employee at a startup, having built a product from the first line of code

• A track record of building and shipping AI or LLM-powered products to real users

• Practical experience with LLM APIs, prompt design, retrieval and evaluating model output in production

• Strong engineering fundamentals across backend and frontend, with the judgement to move fast without leaving a mess behind

• A strong product mindset: you have worked directly with customers and owned a product roadmap

• Hungry, motivated and ready for another zero-to-one journey

• Fluent written and spoken English

Nice to haves:

Experience with our stack: TypeScript (Node.js and React) and Python

Experience with document processing, such as PDF parsing and extraction from unstructured text

Experience building agentic systems, tool use or MCP integrations

Experience with search and retrieval infrastructure, such as Elasticsearch or vector databases

A background in legal tech, governance or B2B SaaS for professional users

What good looks like in this role:

• After three months: you know our customers, the product vision and the codebase, and you have shipped AI features that real users rely on

• After six months: the core AI capabilities of the new product are in production, backed by evaluations that show they are reliable, and you are acting on customer feedback

• After twelve months: the product is in market with paying customers, you are a trusted voice on the roadmap, and the AI foundations you built are reused across the Juristic and Board Intelligence suite

**How We Work

**We hire people who are expert at what they do. Once you join, you have the autonomy to shape how you work and the space to do it well. That doesn’t mean working in isolation. You’ll have colleagues who know their craft, regular collaboration across functions, and easy access to senior leadership when you need it.

We keep our structure flat. We work at pace in an agile, nimble environment where good ideas don’t wait for permission. If you spot something that could work better, we encourage you to say so. If you want to run with an idea, we’ll back you to do it.

We work with people who take pride in their output, back their team through the hard parts, and leave things better than they found them.

**What Happens Next

**Once you apply, our Talent team will review your application. If there’s a fit, they’ll be in touch to discuss the role and next steps.

**How We Use AI In Our Hiring

**We use AI responsibly, both in the software we build for governance teams and in how we hire. Our Talent team may use AI to support application review, CV analysis, or identifying areas that need further verification.

But hiring decisions are made by people. AI surfaces signals; people make the call on whether to progress a candidate or extend an offer.

If you’d like details on how your data is handled during recruitment, contact our Talent team.

**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

**We’re an equal opportunities employer. We’re building a team that works because it reflects a breadth of experience, background, and perspective.

Apply even if you don’t tick every box on the job specification. If the role excites you and you think you could make an impact, we want to hear from you.

We don’t discriminate on the basis of age, disability, ethnicity, gender, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. If you need reasonable adjustments at any stage of recruitment, or if there’s anything else we can do to make the process more accessible, tell our Talent team. We’ll sort it.

**Your Safety Matters

**Be cautious of unexpected messages claiming to be from Board Intelligence. We will never ask you for fees as part of recruitment. If you’re unsure whether a communication is genuine, contact our Talent team through our official channels before sharing information or clicking links.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Do you want to help shape the next chapter of CRH Denmark?

CRH Denmark is on an ambitious journey to build a stronger, more connected and more resilient business. We are bringing our businesses closer together, sharpening our strategic focus and actively pursuing opportunities to strengthen our position across materials, infrastructure and the broader construction value chain.

As our new Senior Strategy & M&A Manager, you will be at the centre of that journey. Working closely with the CRH Denmark leadership team, our businesses and Strategy & Development colleagues across CRH International, you will help shape our long-term direction, drive key strategic analyses and M&A work, and identify the growth opportunities that can define what CRH Denmark becomes next.

The role

As Senior Strategy & M&A Manager, you will take on a broad role spanning long-term strategy, M&A and Business Development. You will lead complex strategic analyses and workstreams, develop recommendations for senior decision-makers and take responsibility for moving strategic opportunities from an initial question or idea to a well-founded decision.

The role combines independent ownership of complex work with close collaboration across CRH Denmark. It gives you the opportunity to work across businesses, markets and different parts of the value chain.

Your key responsibilities will include:

Support our long-term strategy: Help drive the development of CRH Denmark’s long-term 3-to-5-year strategy. You will analyse markets, competitive dynamics, portfolio choices and growth opportunities and translate your insights into clear strategic choices, priorities and recommendations for the leadership team.

• Play a key role in our M&A activities, from opportunity screening and strategic assessment through business cases, valuation and due diligence to decision-making, transaction support and integration planning. You will lead relevant workstreams and coordinate contributions from internal teams and external advisers.

• Identify and assess opportunities beyond traditional M&A, including strategic investments, partnerships, joint ventures and new business models. You will combine strategic, commercial and financial perspectives to determine where new opportunities could create value for CRH Denmark.

• Work closely with the CRH Denmark leadership team and selected businesses as a trusted strategic sparring partner. You will build a deep understanding of their markets, value chains and competitive positions, challenge existing perspectives and proactively bring new strategic questions and opportunities to the table.

• Translate strategic choices and recommendations into clearly defined initiatives with a compelling business case, scope, ambition and high-level plan. You will help mobilise initiatives and remain involved as a strategic partner, while implementation is led by the relevant business or Transformation teams.

Who are you?

You are a highly analytical and commercially minded professional who enjoys solving complex business problems and turning analysis into clear recommendations. You are comfortable taking ownership of your work, engaging with senior stakeholders and challenging established perspectives when the facts point in a different direction.

You combine intellectual curiosity with a pragmatic mindset. You care about the quality of your analysis, but ultimately want your work to lead to better decisions and tangible business outcomes.

We imagine that you:

• Have 4–6 years of relevant experience from management consulting, corporate strategy, corporate development/M&A, investment banking, transaction services or a similar environment.

• Hold a relevant Master’s degree, for example within finance, economics, business or a related field.

• Bring strong analytical, financial and commercial capabilities, including experience with financial modelling, valuation, business cases and the assessment of markets, value chains and business models.

• Are an advanced user of Excel and PowerPoint, comfortable working with complex data and able to translate your analysis into clear and compelling communication for senior decision-makers.

• Work with a high degree of independence and drive, build strong relationships across an organisation and are confident acting as both a collaborative partner and a constructive challenger.

• Are professionally fluent in English and Danish, both written and spoken.

How will you succeed?

In your first months, success will be about building a strong understanding of CRH Denmark, our businesses and markets, establishing trusted relationships across the organisation and quickly becoming able to take ownership of complex strategic and M&A work.

Over time, you will become a trusted strategic partner to the CRH Denmark leadership team and selected businesses. You will be known for combining rigorous analysis with sound commercial judgement, bringing new perspectives and opportunities to the table, and translating complex questions into clear recommendations and actionable strategic initiatives.

Ultimately, you will succeed by helping CRH Denmark make better strategic choices, identify and pursue the right growth opportunities, and continuously strengthen the long-term direction of the business.

The team

You will join Strategy & Transformation, a growing team with a broad mandate to support the development and performance of CRH Denmark. The team works across strategy, M&A and Business Development, PMO, post-merger integration and transformation, as well as operational and commercial performance improvement.

We work closely with the CRH Denmark leadership team and our businesses on some of the most important opportunities and challenges shaping the company. As we continue to build the team and its capabilities, you will have a genuine opportunity to influence how we work, collaborate across disciplines and help shape the Strategy & Transformation function.

You will also be connected to CRH’s wider Strategy & Development community, giving you access to experienced colleagues, specialist capabilities and perspectives from across CRH International.

Meet you new manager, Mads

As a people leader, I believe in freedom under responsibility. We are all here because we bring important experiences and capabilities to the table, which is also why you will experience autonomy to structure and plan your work, but equally high ambitions to deliver. I believe my role is to help set a common vision of what we need to achieve, so our talented colleagues can deliver and execute, as well as enable our colleagues to continuously grow and develop their respective capabilities and careers.

If the above sounds like you, send us your resume - no need for a cover letter.

About CRH Denmark

CRH in Denmark is a leading supplier of precast concrete elements and solutions for both construction and infrastructure projects. We employ approximately 1,500 people across 22 locations and cover the entire value chain—from raw materials and concrete to paving, pipe and manhole systems, and structural solutions.

CRH in Denmark consists of CRH Concrete, CRH Products, Magnus Holm, and Bedsted Lø Grusværker. Together, we deliver solutions for buildings, roads, urban spaces, utilities, and technical infrastructure.

Sustainability is a strategic priority. Our goal is to develop solutions that build, connect, and improve our world.

Learn more at: www.crhconcrete.dk, www.crhproducts.dk, and www.grus.dk

**What You Bring

**

• Demonstrate experience providing onsite enterprise IT support and resolving hardware and software issues.

**What We Offer

**

• Gain international exposure by collaborating with Global IT teams and colleagues across multiple countries.

• Develop your technical skills through hands-on experience with enterprise technologies and diverse IT environments.

• Build your career within a global organization with opportunities for professional growth and continuous learning.

• Work in a collaborative environment where your technical expertise directly contributes to business operations.

• Gain exposure to a broad range of technologies, projects, and IT functions.

• Be part of an inclusive workplace that values collaboration, diversity, and different perspectives.

• Enjoy competitive local-market compensation and benefits.

**SIEM Lead in the Cyber Defense team

**As SIEM Lead, you will be the owner of our SIEM application (Splunk Enterprise Security) used by TDC NET’s Cyber Defense team. Your work will help analysts detect and investigate threats across our IT systems and Denmark’s critical telecommunications infrastructure.

**About The Job

**Your focus will be the SIEM application, its detections and the workflows analysts use every day. A dedicated engineering team in another department operates the underlying platform. You will work with that team on security data requirements and with the Head of Analysts to prioritize improvements.

Our work is guided by threat intelligence. The wider Cyber Defense team covers detection and response, threat hunting, detection engineering, incident response and forensics, penetration testing and red teaming, vulnerability management, anti-abuse and security postmaster services.

Your responsibilities

• Own the SIEM application for the Cyber Defense team, defining its roadmap and priorities with the Head of Analysts and coordinating delivery with the engineering team.

• Assess gaps in SIEM capabilities, data coverage and investigation workflows, and turn findings into a prioritized improvement plan. Track progress through measures of coverage and alert quality.

• Maintain investigation dashboards, reusable searches and security context, including threat intelligence and asset and identity information used to enrich alerts.

• Define logging and data requirements for the engineering team. Validate that delivered data contains the fields, timestamps and context needed for detection and investigation.

• Act as the technical lead for SIEM analysis during major incidents, coordinating with incident response colleagues.

• Mentor analysts in SIEM use, alert analysis and investigation techniques, and review detection content and tuning decisions with the team.

• Validate detections with the Security Testing team through attack simulations and purple team exercises and follow up on missed or incomplete alerts.

Our Cyber Defense team is Trusted Introducer certified, and our Security Testing team is CREST certified.

You will join approximately 45 colleagues in TDC NET Security, with an open, informal working culture where people share knowledge and challenge ideas.

The Cyber Defense team operates a 24/7 on-call rotation. As Senior Security Analyst, you will participate in this rotation, investigating and responding to security incidents outside normal working hours.

**About You

**You are an experienced (3-5+ years of experience) security analyst with solid practical SIEM knowledge and the ability to turn operational needs into clear priorities. You can make sound decisions with incomplete information, coordinate technical analysis under pressure and communicate findings and uncertainty clearly to both technical and non-technical colleagues.

**We Are Looking For Experience In The Following Areas

**

• Working with SIEM capabilities, data flows, integrations and application configuration in a production SOC or Cyber Defense environment.

• Taking ownership of a SIEM application, assessing gaps and defining a practical, prioritized roadmap in collaboration with analysts and platform engineers.

• Investigating incidents and hunting for threats using endpoint, identity, network and application logs, with an understanding of data quality and normalization.

• Using threat intelligence and MITRE ATT&CK to define detection requirements and identify gaps in coverage.

• Translating security needs into clear requirements for engineers and providing practical guidance to less experienced analysts.

• Understanding offensive techniques such as exploitation, privilege escalation and lateral movement, and the evidence they leave in logs.

• Using penetration tests, red team findings or purple team exercises to validate detections and close monitoring gaps.

• You must be able to maintain security clearance at HEMMELIGT (SECRET) level throughout your employment.

Experience with scripting, automation and version control is welcome.

Relevant higher education and security certifications are also welcome.

Are you passionate about cutting-edge electronics design? Do you want to help develop the world’s best spectrometer electronics – and make a real difference in industries ranging from green energy to healthcare?

Join Ibsen Photonics – a global leader in optical innovation.

We’re looking for a talented electronics design engineer to join our R&D team, where we design and build state-of-the-art, transmission grating based spectrometers in collaboration with international customers.

Why join us?

At Ibsen Photonics, we combine world-class technology with a strong sense of purpose. Our products help advance green energy, improve healthcare diagnostics, and enable innovation across a wide range of industries.

Since 2014, we have fivefold our revenue, reaching annual sales of more than 150 MDKK. We are 85 dedicated colleagues working from our R&D and manufacturing facility in Farum, just outside Copenhagen.

• An important role in a fast-growing, financially strong company

• A culture built on trust, collaboration, freedom with responsibility, and swift decision-making

• Opportunities to work with leading international companies in many different industries

• A workplace where your ideas matter – and where you will see them come to life

Your role: Electronics design engineer

As part of our 12-person R&D team, you will play an important role in design of high speed, low noise electronics for our spectrometers and our production and test setups. You will work closely with customers and colleagues across disciplines to bring new products from concept to production.

Your tasks will include:

• Development of hardware for our optical sensors with end-to-end ownership

• Design for reliable and robust manufacture and operation

• Troubleshooting production and test issues

• Coordinating and managing development projects

• Validating and documenting your work

What you bring

You are both technically strong and a great team player. Ideally, you have:

• A degree in engineering or similar, and minimum 5 years experience with design of electronics

• Mastering of most disciplines within analogue and digital electronics, with focus on high speed digital electronics, including FPGA programming (VHDL) and MCU programming (C/C++)

• Experienced user of Altium or similar for Schematic/PCB layout and simulation

• Experience with optical sensors and cameras is an advantage

• A structured, analytical approach to problem-solving

• A proactive mindset and a good sense of humour

You will have the opportunity to shape the future of our electronics design capabilities – and grow with us as we expand.

What we offer

• Flexible working hours

• A friendly, respectful work environment with regular social events

• A culture where everyone contributes to a shared goal – and takes pride in the result

About Ibsen Photonics

Ibsen’s core technology is optical transmission gratings and grating based spectrometers, which we design, manufacture and supply to customers worldwide. Our spectrometers find their way into medical devices and scientific instruments used in sustainable energy, industrial, pharmaceutical, life sciences, security, and many other applications.

We work closely with our customers to create value adding solutions, sharing our extensive technical knowledge in an open and honest work environment with a flat “Scandinavian” hierarchical structure.

You will join a rapidly growing company employing 100 people at our facility just north of Copenhagen, and realising a turnover of more than 200 MDKK in 2026. We work actively with the UN’s Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and strive to make our business fully sustainable.

Ibsen Photonics is majority owned N. Foss & Co. A/S, a world leader in analytical solutions for the agricultural industry, with an annual turnover of 2.5 Billion DKK and more than 1.800 employees.

**WHY SPEKTR

**At spektr, we are on a mission to automate the world’s most complex compliance workflows through AI. Founded by the team behind HelloFlow (acquired by Trulioo), spektr is building the infrastructure and AI agents to run compliance at scale.

_Compliance, built like product.

_Financial services has changed enormously. Much of the technology behind compliance hasn’t. Teams still spend hours on manual checks, disconnected systems slow down launches, and entering a new market can mean rebuilding the same processes all over again.

We’re changing that. spektr gives regulated businesses one platform for onboarding, monitoring and investigations, with configurable workflows and AI agents that do the legwork. Product, Operations and Compliance can move together, with the control they need to grow.

It’s a huge opportunity in an industry that has moved slowly for too long. We’ve built a product we’re proud to put in front of the most demanding customers. Now we’re looking for people who want to help get it into their hands.

• $26M raised, including a $20M Series A led by NEA, with backing from Northzone, Seedcamp and PreSeed Ventures.

• Customers worth getting excited about. We work with businesses including Pleo, Trustly, Nexi and Santander. These are large accounts with complex problems, ambitious teams and plenty of room for us to make a difference.

• Three offices: Copenhagen, London and Iași, with customers across more than 15 countries.

**THE OPPORTUNITY

**We are looking for an AI Engineer who is, first and foremost, a product builder. In this role, you won't just be running experiments in a notebook; you will own the end-to-end AI strategy and its direct impact on our customers.

In this role, you will own everything related to AI, LLMs, and intelligent automation.

This is a high-impact role in a fast-growing company. We are looking for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment, loves solving complex compliance puzzles, and is eager to shape the next generation of compliance technology.

**What You Will Be Doing

**

• AI Strategy & Ownership: Own the end-to-end AI roadmap—from selecting the right models (SOTA commercial vs. fine-tuned open source) to deciding how they are integrated into the product core.

• Agentic Feature Design: Design and deploy LLM-powered features including autonomous agents, advanced RAG pipelines, and intelligent document understanding.

• Product-Led AI: Collaborate directly with founders to translate complex compliance "puzzles" into scalable AI solutions. You own the "Why" behind every model choice.

• Continuous Innovation: Stay at the bleeding edge of AI/ML research, proactively identifying new papers or releases that can give spektr a competitive advantage.

• Engineering for Reliability: Turn non-deterministic AI outputs into deterministic product value. You ensure our agents are accurate, explainable, and hallucination-free.

**What We Are Looking For

**

• The Product Mindset: You are a product person at heart. You care about whether the AI actually solves the user's problem, not just if the loss curve is going down.

• High-Agency Builder: You prefer building systems over following manuals. You identify bottlenecks in our AI workflows and fix them before they become tickets.

• AI/ML Expertise: 2+ years of experience in ML, AI, or Data/Backend roles with a deep understanding of modern LLM stacks.

• Technical Mastery: Strong skills in TypeScript (our core) and/or Python, with hands-on experience in frameworks like LangChain or equivalent orchestration layers.

• RAG & Vector Mastery: You’ve built production-grade RAG pipelines and understand the nuances of embedding, retrieval strategy, and re-ranking.

• Evaluation Obsession: You understand that "it works on my machine" doesn't apply to LLMs. You have experience setting up evaluation frameworks to measure and improve model performance.

• Cloud & Scale: Experience deploying AI services in AWS or containerized environments, ensuring they are scalable and cost-effective.

• Communication: You can explain the trade-offs of a specific model architecture to a founder and a technical bottleneck to a peer with equal clarity.

**OUR TECH INTERESTS

**

• Models: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, and Open Source (LLaMA, Mistral).

• Stack: TypeScript, Python, LangChain, etc

• Infra: AWS, Kubernetes, CI/CD for LLMs.

**OUR PROCESS

**

• Intro call with our Talent team (30 minutes)

• Technical Interview (30 minutes)

• Technical Interview (60 minutes)

**How To Apply

**We hire the smartest, kindest, and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work. You’ll be joining a team with a proven track record and the "Product-Market Fit" to change an entire industry.
